rounds.prompt:
Documentary photograph aesthetic, unretouched, fine film grain.

A paper wall calendar close up, its grid of empty cells filling the frame at a slight angle. A woman's hand enters from the right edge holding a pen over one cell that carries a grey smudge of erased pencil, a few eraser crumbs on the ledge below. The moment before she writes it again. Tired, careful, unposed.

FG: the eraser crumbs on the ledge, slightly below centre. MG: the hand and the pen, occupying the right third. BG: the plain wall around the calendar, softly defocused.

Light: cool daylight from the right, soft and flat; the left side of the calendar falls into gentle shade.

Composition: rule of thirds. The hand and the pen fill the right third; the lower left quadrant is calm empty calendar cells, left clear for copy added later.

Angle: eye-level, slightly off axis, with comfortable margin around the subject on all sides.

Focus: hard focus on the smudge under the pen tip. Set to 50mm, medium depth of field so the background stays readable during a slow push in.

Tone: Low Saturation Gray palette, muted grey-green and warm beige. Natural skin texture with visible pores, matte skin with no shine, believable proportions and natural hands.

The subject reads clearly against the background in tone and value.

Overall vibe: the fourth call about the same Thursday.

The calendar cells are empty and unmarked, the wall plain and unbranded, every surface clean and free of lettering.

FG: the eraser crumbs on the narrow ledge, slightly below centre. MG: the hand and the pencil over the smudged cell, occupying the right third. BG: the remaining blank cells and thin grey lines, softly defocused toward the left.

Light: cool daylight from the right, soft and flat; the left cells fall into gentle shade.

Composition: rule of thirds. The hand and the pencil fill the right third; the lower left quadrant is one calm empty white cell, left clear for copy added later.

Angle: eye-level, slightly off axis, with comfortable margin around the subject on all sides.

Focus: hard focus on the graphite smudge under the pencil tip. Set to 50mm, medium depth of field so the background stays readable during a slow push in.

Tone: Low Saturation Gray palette, muted grey-green and warm beige. Natural skin texture with visible pores, matte skin with no shine, believable proportions and natural hands.

The subject reads clearly against the background in tone and value.

Overall vibe: the fourth call about the same Thursday.

Every cell is blank white bounded only by thin grey lines, the ledge bare and unmarked, every surface clean and free of lettering and free of digits.
